['Alba SE '].company_description: Alba SE is a German professional basketball club based in Berlin, Germany. It is considered to be the most successful German basketball team, having won eleven German Championships, eleven German Cups, three German Supercups, and the FIBA Korać Cup in 1995. The club competes in the German League and the EuroLeague or the EuroCup, and hosts its home games at the Mercedes-Benz Arena Berlin. With an average attendance of more than 10,000 fans per game in a season, it is also one of the most popular basketball clubs in Europe.
